gog.store_details: This is the original 1998 Baldur's Gate with its Tales of the Sword Coast expansion, not 2012's 'Enhanced Edition'. GOG stopped selling it by November 2016 (per GOG's forums), but it's still an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Baldur's Gate ships with 'Environmental Audio' unset and only turns it on by itself the first time it starts with EAX available.

sources.title: GOG forum: BGEE, BG2EE, IWEE vs originals
